desc:
🐣 Steal An Egg! 🥚

🌟 Collect, Hatch, Upgrade & Steal!

🥚 Snatch eggs from adorable pets!
🐥 Crack open eggs to unlock amazing pets!
🪙 Generate cash with your pet collection!
🏡 Improve your base and upgrade your treadmill!
⚡ Boost your speed by training on the treadmill!
🦹 Sneak into other players' bases and steal their eggs!
💎 Unlock legendary eggs, unique pets, different sizes, and special mutations!

🕹️ Play anywhere! Available on PC, Console, Phone & Tablet!
